classification.reason: The customer is only asking for clarification on how the annual discount works (not requesting a refund or exception), and billing_faq.md clearly confirms annual billing includes a 20% discount versus monthly.

draft.reply:
Hi there,

Thanks for checking in! Yes, that's expected — annual plans are billed as a single upfront payment for the full year, rather than in monthly installments. That upfront annual charge is exactly what includes the 20% discount compared to paying monthly. For example, on the Team plan, monthly billing is $15/user/month, while annual billing works out to $12/user/month (billed all at once for the year) — that's the 20% savings.

So the discount isn't a separate charge or credit — it's already built into the lower annual rate you were charged. If you'd like to see the full breakdown, you can find your invoice under Settings > Billing > Invoices.

Let me know if you have any other questions!

Best,
Loopwise Support
